note: Deep-dive #6. Uses Microsoft Entra External ID (an external tenant), not Azure AD B2C (closed to new customers). Each customer in its own InPrivate window. The Power Pages site is a trial site.
prepare: # owner signs in (device code), not recorded

# manual: Entra admin center > Manage tenants > Create > External, name 'Contoso customers', domain contosocustomers (or next free), location Europe, subscription = lab, resource group rg-mglab-deep-dive-06
# manual: Dataverse table 'Support request' in solution 'Customer portal' (DEV) exactly as dataverse/support-request-table.json, main form with the Document Locations subgrid, document management on

# manual: accounts Northwind Traders and Adventure Works; contacts Riley Demo, Alex Demo (Northwind), Taylor Demo (Adventure Works) with the exact e-mail they sign up with; one seed request each for Alex and Taylor
# manual: SharePoint site /sites/customer-docs and server-based SharePoint integration for DEV; Power Pages site 'Contoso support', SharePoint Integration = Yes
$env:MG_EXT_TENANT = Read-Host 'External tenant ID (owner types, never recorded)'; $env:MG_REPLY_URL = Read-Host 'Reply URL from the Power Pages identity provider wizard (owner types)'
./external-id/Initialize-ExternalId.ps1 -TenantId $env:MG_EXT_TENANT -ReplyUrl $env:MG_REPLY_URL -WhatIf   # owner signs in as the external tenant admin
./external-id/Initialize-ExternalId.ps1 -TenantId $env:MG_EXT_TENANT -ReplyUrl $env:MG_REPLY_URL   # second run: Exists for all five steps
# manual: paste Client ID, Authority, Metadata address in the wizard; contact mapping with email = On; external logout = On

# manual: web role 'Customer contacts' on the three contacts; table permissions tree from portal/table-permissions.json; page /support/ with page permission; site settings from portal/site-settings.json; web file support-requests.js; web template from portal/web-templates/my-requests.html; page /support/request/ with the update form
# manual: dry run with all four people in separate InPrivate windows, then delete the requests the dry run created (keep the two seed requests)

screens.name: external-id-signup
screens.url: https://<portal-host>/ (the Contoso support site, InPrivate window)
screens.account: none (Riley Demo signs up during the take)
steps: Open the portal home in an InPrivate window
Sign in > Microsoft Entra External ID (Contoso customers)
On the external tenant's sign-up page: Riley Demo's e-mail, Next, the one-time verification code from the lab mailbox, a password, name Riley Demo
Back on the portal: signed in as Riley Demo, the Support menu item is visible
mask: portal host name in the address bar
contents of the verification e-mail except its subject

screens.name: support-requests
steps: As Riley open /support/: Alex's Northwind request is listed, Taylor's Adventure Works request is not
Submit a new request: 'Pallet arrived damaged', category Delivery
Message 'Request sent' appears; the new row is at the top with its SR-0000x reference, marked as hers
mask: contact and record GUIDs in links

screens.name: request-documents
steps: Open Riley's new request (basic form, mode 'Updates an existing record')
In the documents subgrid upload pallet-photos.pdf
Second capture: as labadmin open the SharePoint site Customer docs > the Support request library > the folder named after the request: the PDF is inside
mask: tenant name in the SharePoint address

screens.name: isolation
steps: (a) As Taylor (Adventure Works contact) open /support/: only Adventure Works rows
(b) As Jordan (signed up, no registered contact) open /support/: the access denied page

(c) As Riley open the browser console and run ContosoSupport.createClient({fetch: fetch.bind(window), getToken: () => ContosoSupport.tokenFromShell(shell)}).createRequest({title: 'Forged request', category: 100000003}, '<Alex contact ID>') and show the rejected promise (HTTP status and message)
If the forged create succeeds, STOP: it is a finding. Note it in the README, delete the row and re-record without (c)
mask: Alex's contact GUID in the console command

teardown: # manual: Power Platform admin center > Power Pages: delete the 'Contoso support' site; delete solution 'Customer portal' and the seed accounts and contacts in DEV; turn off server-based SharePoint integration if it was off before
# manual: SharePoint: delete the 'Customer docs' site and remove it from the deleted sites
# manual: external tenant: delete every user except the admin, the user flow, all app registrations including b2c-extensions-app, then Manage tenants > Delete 'Contoso customers'
az group delete -n rg-mglab-deep-dive-06 --yes   # once the tenant resource is gone
needs: licence:Power Apps Premium self-service trial for labadmin (Power Pages Management app)
